lead.headline: James Madison goes from fifth to first, and App State scores 50 at Yale
lead.deck: The Dukes won three times by an average of 44 points. App State lost twice. Arkansas State scored 310 points in three games.
body: James Madison won 70-52 at Towson as a 3.5-point favorite. Then it beat Charleston Southern 82-58, and beat Virginia Lynchburg, which isn't a Division I team, 136-45. Count the first two and the Dukes still won by 21 a game. They jump from fifth to first in the power rankings. Our model has them 92nd nationally, plus-9.0 per 100 possessions, the best rating in the league by five points.

App State went the other way, from first to second, and that's being kind. The Mountaineers beat North Texas 81-75, lost at home to St. Bonaventure 71-65, then lost 57-50 at Yale. Fifty points in a game is a brick wall, and we know brick walls.

Arkansas State, the preseason favorite, scored 100 against Arkansas-Pine Bluff and 104 against Southern Utah, winning that one on Layne Taylor's three-pointer with 2:41 left. Then the Red Wolves went to Long Beach State and won 106-81, with Taylor scoring 25. That's 310 points in three games. They climbed from eighth to fifth.
Old Dominion has the best record at 6-1 and beat Hampton 71-59. The model has the Monarchs 131st and the power rankings dropped them to third. Being 6-1 in November gets you only so far.
The league went 20-13 this week. Louisiana Tech's Fenner was named the Sun Belt's player of the week, according to the conference.

column.label: Look Ahead
column.title: A MAC visitor and the biggest total on the board
body: **Arkansas State at FIU, today, 3:30 p.m.** The total is 176. After the Red Wolves' week, 176 might be low. FIU is a 2-point favorite at home.
**Akron at App State, today, 3 p.m.** The Mountaineers are 5-point underdogs at home to a MAC team, and after the 50 at Yale, it's easy to see why. This is a chance to show the Yale game was a fluke.
**Prairie View at Marshall, today, 4 p.m.** The Herd are 13.5-point favorites. Marshall lost 88-72 at North Carolina this week. Noah Otshudi had 18 there.

notes.headline: Troy's Donovan Oday scored 37
notes.body: Oday had 37 points and six rebounds in a 78-77 win at Nicholls. The Trojans lost at home to Valparaiso the night before.

notes.headline: Southern Miss went 3-0 on the road
notes.body: The Golden Eagles won 103-100 at Grambling, 80-69 at Nicholls and 99-89 at Valparaiso. Jalyke Gaines-Wyatt had eight assists in the first one.

notes.headline: Louisiana's lost week
notes.body: The Ragin' Cajuns lost 77-56 at San Francisco and 82-56 at USC, then beat Louisiana Christian, which isn't a Division I team, 91-24. That last score is not a misprint.

notes.headline: Circle it: Arkansas State at FIU
notes.body: Today, 3:30 p.m. ET. FIU by 2, total 176. Bring a calculator.
